## 🔄 Migration Guide

### Breaking Changes

If you're upgrading from v{PREVIOUS_VERSION}, please note:

1. **Change 1:** What changed and how to migrate
2. **Change 2:** What changed and how to migrate

**Example:**
```javascript
// Before (v0.0.1)
import { OldAPI } from 'vibesmith';

// After (v0.1.0)
import { NewAPI } from 'vibesmith';
```

### Database Migration

⚠️ **Automatic:** Database will be migrated automatically on first launch. Backup recommended.

```bash
# Backup your database (recommended)
cp ~/.local/share/vibesmith/db.sqlite ~/.local/share/vibesmith/db.sqlite.backup
```

| Issue | Severity | Workaround |
